Read in file from drep
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)

winners <- read.csv("D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/dRep_DASTool_339/data_tables/Widb.csv", header = TRUE)

```



Get GTDB output from METABOLIC run
```{r}
gtdb <- read.delim("D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/gtdb_output_bestMAGsonly/65MAGs/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv", header = TRUE)

# Remove .fa extension from genome names for matching
winners <- winners %>%
  mutate(genome_base = sub("\\.fa$", "", genome))

# Merge using cleaned genome names
merged <- winners %>%
  left_join(gtdb, by = c("genome_base" = "user_genome"))

# Extract genus name from classification string
merged$genus <- sub(".*;g__([^;]+).*", "\\1", merged$classification)
#do it in this data frame as well, will be helpful to see all bins genus later
gtdb$genus <- sub(".*;g__([^;]+).*", "\\1", gtdb$classification)

```



Still need contigs, can get it from checkm
```{r}
checkm <- read.csv(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/checkm_dastool_all20_combined.csv",
  colClasses = c(culture = "character", genome_base = "character")
)

checkm <- checkm %>%
  mutate(
    old_bin_name = genome_base,

    # Remove the old metaSPAdes wording
    genome_base = str_remove(genome_base, "_metaSPAdes"),

    # Rename numeric CONCOCT bins
    genome_base = if_else(
      str_detect(genome_base, "^\\d+(_sub)?$"),
      paste0(culture, "_concoct.", genome_base),
      genome_base
    )
  )

```



Merge & export
```{r}
final_data <- merged %>%
  left_join(
    checkm %>%
      select(
        genome_base,
        number_of_contigs,
        genome_size_bp
      ),
    by = "genome_base"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    `Bin Identity` = genus,
    `Culture Origin` = genome_base,
    `Bin completeness` = completeness,
    `Bin contamination` = contamination,
    `Number of contigs` = number_of_contigs,
    `Size of genome (bp)` = genome_size_bp
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Bin Identity`)

# Export
write.csv(final_data, "BestMAGs_65.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
